drinks.name: Coors Light - 12oz
drinks.description: Light, lager beer, known for its crisp, clean and refreshing taste.
drinks.extended_description: A light lager that delivers an ice cold refreshing taste. Contains lightly toasted two-row barley, selected hops from around the world, Coors' cherished yeast strain, maize and water. With subtle kettle hop character, mild maltiness and fresh fruity notes of green apple and banana.

drinks.name: Corona Extra - 12oz
drinks.description: Even-keeled cerveza with fruity-honey aromas and a touch of malt.
drinks.extended_description: Corona Extra is an iconic 4.6% ABV pale Mexican lager introduced in 1925. Brewed with water, malted barley, hops, and corn, it features a light body, crisp and refreshing taste with subtle fruit and honey malt notes, and a clean finish.

drinks.name: Corona Premier - 12oz - Low Carb
drinks.description: Premium, light lager beer from Mexico
drinks.extended_description: Corona Premier is a smooth, low-carb Mexican light lager with 90 calories, 2.6 grams of carbohydrates, and a 4% alcohol-by-volume (ABV) per 12 oz serving. It delivers a crisp, clean, and dry finish with subtle malt sweetness and low bitterness.

drinks.name: Modelo Especial - 12oz
drinks.description: Mexican Pilsner-style lager known for its crisp, refreshing taste and well-balanced flavor.
drinks.extended_description: A benchmark of our deep brewing heritage, this rich, full-flavored Pilsner-style Mexican lager showcases our commitment to quality in every pour. Well-balanced taste and light hop character with a crisp finish. Characterized by an orange blossom honey aroma with a hint of herb. Contains water, barley malt, non-malted cereals, and hops

drinks.name: Hazy Little Thing IPA - 12oz
drinks.description: IPA known for its juicy, fruit-forward flavors and smooth, silky mouthfeel.
drinks.extended_description: Sierra Nevada brews Hazy Little Thing with the finest ingredients for the purest quality in every sip.  Brewed to be juicy, but not sweet. Hoppy, but not bitter. Velvety smooth and handcrafted with Citra and Mosaic hops.

drinks.name: Cavit Pinot Noir - 187 ml
drinks.description: Bright cherry, strawberry, and red raspberry. Light-to-medium body with soft, gentle tannins
drinks.extended_description:
A youthful, vibrant purple. Delicate and alluring aromas of black cherry. Silky smooth with well defined fruit redolent of red berries and cherries; medium-bodied with soft tannins, concluding in a stylish finish. Pairs well with grilled or roasted red meats, poultry, flavorful vegetarian entrees, risottos. Enjoy with fish such as salmon, tuna and swordfish.
Planet Grape: 91
Wine Enthusiasts: 89

drinks.name: Cavit Pinot Grigio - 187ml
drinks.description: Light refreshing flavors of citrus and green apple
drinks.extended_description:
Bright straw gold color. On the nose is delicate and pleasing with floral and fruit scents. The palate is dry, light and crisp. A wonderful aperitif and equally splendid with pasta in cream sauces, risottos, veal, chicken and fresh dishes. 
Wine Enthusiast: 87
Wine Spectator:88

drinks.name: Bonanza Chardonnay - 375ml
drinks.description: Fruit-forward California white emphasizing crisp melon, fresh floral aromas, and vibrant acidity
drinks.extended_description: Nose: Aromas of light melon, fresh white flowers, green apple, and crisp pear with subtle citrus and vanilla hints.  Palate: Medium-bodied with flavors of ripe peach, tropical fruit, and lemon curd, rounded out by a clean, vibrant acidity.  Finish: Smooth, crisp, and refreshing with a clean, lingering citrus-zest close.  Wine Spectator: 90 Wine Enthusiast:88

drinks.name: Imagery Chardonnay - 750ml
drinks.description: Subtle oak and balanced flavors of green and vanilla, followed by complex layers of fruit and spice.
drinks.extended_description: Crisp and elegant, this Chardonnay radiates aromas of apple, lime and pear. Subtle oak and and a touch of Chenin Blanc, boost this wine’s brightness and overall liveliness. Balanced flavors of green apple and vanilla, followed by complex layers of fruit and spice lead to an elegant creamy finish. Natural varietal characteristics of Chardonnay shine through without being overshadowed by dominant oak notes. Wine Enthusiast: 89 Wine Spectator: 92
